instructions:
## Objective

Transfer MNIST classification through a teacher’s three auxiliary outputs without exposing digits or labels to the student.

## Work to perform

Generate up to 40,000 synthetic student inputs and choose epochs, learning rate and batch size. Architecture, shared initialization recipe, teacher training and student loss stay fixed. Test protocols locally before submitting Python code.

## Deliverable

One Python protocol file.

## Evaluation

Accuracy over eight initializations with wrong-teacher controls subtracting transfer unrelated to shared initialization. Reliability and leakage checks modify the score.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
